items.title: Microsoft Teams: Show your shared content on both room displays
items.description: Make presentations easier to see from anywhere in the room, even when you're not in a Teams meeting. On Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android with dual displays, content you share through an HDMI connection can now appear on both screens at once. You can start or stop showing your content on both screens from the room controls. Admins can use settings to manage how this works in their rooms.

items.title: SharePoint: Organization-wide page templates
items.description: We are introducing organization-wide page templates in SharePoint, enabling organizations to provide reusable, approved starting points for page creation across sites within a tenant. Managed centrally in the SharePoint site associated with your organization's brand center, these templates help authors reduce repetitive setup and create pages with consistent content.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: UTGST Tax support in Commerce [India Tax Localization]
items.description:
This feature adds UTGST (Union Territory Goods and Services Tax) to the Commerce channel - store Commerce/POS/Trade POS and e‑commerce transactions in union territories.
What UTGST is: For union territories in India that don't have a legislature, the GST Council introduced UTGST, which is comparable to SGST. UTGST applies to the following union territories of India: Chandigarh Lakshadweep Daman and Diu Dadra and Nagar Haveli Andaman and Nicobar Islands. Delhi and Puducherry have their own legisl

items.title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: ATP with customer & product lead time
items.description:
This feature adds lead times set per customer or per product to the ATP promise date, so the date reflects how each customer and each item is actually served.
Customer lead time: time that applies to everything shipped to a given customer, such as agreed service levels, delivery schedules, or extra handling and documentation.
Product lead time: time that applies to a given item whoever orders it, such as packing, quality checks, kitting or vendor lead time for items you don't stock.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Configurable ATP with Receipt Control
items.description:
This feature lets a business choose which incoming supply counts when the system calculates available-to-promise (ATP), so delivery promises match its own order-promising policy. It is in preview from version 10.0.50.
It allows business to design ATP calculations for their business needs through different parameters to exclude purchase order or transfer order or production order. By default, these are not excluded.

items.title: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration: Unify finance and operations system administrator user and role management in Power Platform admin center
items.description: Administrators can now manage system administrator users and security roles for both finance and operations apps and Dataverse from a single, unified experience in Power Platform admin center. Instead of switching between the finance and operations Users and Security configuration pages and the Dataverse user and role pages, admins can add and enable users, assign and remove roles, and review user access across both from one place. This generally available release follows the public preview and
products: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

items.title: Dynamics 365 Human Resources: Agent onboarding for new employees
items.description:
Business value
Onboarding in Dynamics 365 Human Resources spans several pages and two people: HR administrators hire the candidate, enroll leave and set compensation, while the new employee completes personal details, address, emergency contacts and identification. Steps are easy to miss.
A new agentic onboarding experience will brings the tasks into one guided conversation over live Human Resources data. Every change is previewed and confirmed explicitly, and all reads and writes run under the

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Enable Project Revenue recognition using cost estimate instead of EAC (estimate at complete)
items.description:
When you enable the Enable Project Revenue recognition using the cost estimate instead of the EAC (estimate at complete) setting, you activate this feature.

Uses the original project estimate for PoC calculations: Delivers stable, predictable revenue without EAC-driven fluctuations.
Anchors revenue recognition to a fixed baseline: Improves transparency and boosts confidence in reported project financials.
Reduces reliance on changing forecasts: Minimizes rework and exceptions during month-end c

items.title: Microsoft Viva - Viva Glint: Enhanced multi-attribute report exports
items.description: Enhancements that are a part of this release expand who can use the Multi-attribute report export, increases the supported scale, and gives authorized users more control over the questions and attributes included.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Plan further ahead with 180-day hourly schedule board view
items.description:
Scheduling teams planning work over several months need to see upcoming bookings while retaining an hourly view of their schedules. The current hourly view supports up to 28 days. The planned extended view is designed to help teams review bookings across a longer planning horizon without switching to a less detailed view, or paging through multiple time periods. Loading and refresh improvements aim to reduce waiting as teams review and update their schedules.
Administrators can configure the pla

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Custom tooltips and templates on schedule board aggregate views
items.description:
Scheduling teams planning multiday work do so using the aggregate views on the schedule board - the daily, weekly, and monthly views. On those views, multiple bookings are aggregated into a single object that spans the entire period.
This improvement will allow administrators to configure the template and tooltips that are available on those views, so they can display information relevant to their dispatchers Custom html templates will bind to the requirement, rather than the booking, allowing f

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Activity Approvals Agent
items.description:
The Approvals Agent in Dynamics 365 Project Operations uses AI to perform an initial review of submitted time, expense, and material entries against policy documents written in natural language. It classifies entries as Ready for approval or Needs review, helping project managers prioritize entries that require attention.
Organizations can choose between two operating modes. In Classify mode, approvers review the agent’s classifications and manually approve entries. In Classify and auto approve

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Mark all eligible actuals ready to invoice in bulk
items.description:
Before you can invoice a project, every eligible unbilled sales actual has to be marked ready to invoice. Today, project managers and billing administrators do that by selecting records in a grid that's capped at 1,000 per page, then repeating the action page after page. For firms with tens of thousands of actuals in a billing cycle, that adds up to hours of repetitive work before a single invoice gets created.
Now you can mark every eligible actual for a project, contract, or contract line in o

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Raise your hand to speak up at large events with up to 100,000 attendees
items.description: Ask your questions live and take part in the conversation, even at events with up to 100,000 attendees. In events this size, attendees can now raise their hand in Teams when they have a question. Organizers can then let people with a raised hand turn on their mic and camera to ask their question or speak during the event.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Share reactions at events with up to 100,000 attendees
items.description: Stay more engaged and connected with the audience, even at events with up to 100,000 attendees. Teams now supports reactions in events at this scale. You can send reactions during the event and see the reactions others send, so everyone can share the moment together.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Workflow to automatically add tag members to relevant channels
items.description: Associate channels with a tag so members are automatically added to those channels when they join the tag. This helps teams keep channel membership in sync with evolving groups, reduces manual management, and ensures members have access to the conversations and content most relevant to their role.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live support for webinars and structured meetings on Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: Participants joining webinars and structured meetings from Teams Rooms on Android can view and interact with PowerPoint Live presentations. This provides greater flexibility and accessibility while keeping room participants aligned with the active presentation.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling for legacy Office files
items.description: Microsoft Purview server-side auto-labeling will support legacy Microsoft Office file formats, including Word (.doc), Excel (.xls), and PowerPoint (.ppt). Organizations can automatically evaluate and apply sensitivity labels to these files in SharePoint and OneDrive.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Increase in expansion limit for auto-expanding archive beyond 1.5 TB
items.description: Previously, auto-expanding archive mailbox expansion was supported only up to 1.5 TB, after which mailboxes would become inoperative. Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the 1.5 TB limit, ensuring uninterrupted retention and enabling scalable archive growth as storage thresholds are reached. This capability to expand archives beyond 1.5 TB will be available to customers with eligible E5 licenses.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Onboarding workflow for new team members
items.description: Help people get started faster by automatically connecting new team members to relevant channels when they join a team. Improve engagement, accelerate onboarding, and make it easier to discover important information from day one.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling per-policy coverage report
items.description: For each enforced auto-labeling policy, admins can view how files processed during enforcement correlate to the latest simulation run. The per-policy coverage report shows volumes of files that have been labeled or are not yet labeled, and whether those files were included in the last simulation snapshot. This helps admins understand enforcement progress for a specific policy against the data state captured during simulation, while also identifying files that were not found in the simulation sna

items.title: Outlook: Manage Multiple Inbox Rules at Once
items.description: You will soon be able to manage multiple inbox rules at the same time. Select every rule or choose only the ones you want to update. You can then delete, enable, or disable the selected rules in one action. This makes it faster and easier to keep your rules organized. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Engage: New left navigation controls — collapse, resize, increased favorites cap, and reorder favorites capabilities
items.description: We're introducing a set of left-navigation improvements in Viva Engage on the web that give people more control over their navigation pane. These are additive, user-driven changes — users can collapse the left nav, resize its width, favorite up to 50 communities, and drag to reorder their favorited communities. None of these changes alter which destinations appear in the navigation. These enhancements are applicable to all surfaces that have the Engage left navigation menu - Web, and the Engage

items.title: Outlook: Categorize Emails by Dragging Them onto a Favorite Category
items.description: You can now add a category to your Favorites and then drag emails right onto it to apply that category. No need to open menus or right-click each message. Just pin the category you use most to Favorites, then drop your emails on it to tag them in one quick motion. It's a faster, more visual way to keep your inbox sorted the way you like. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Microsoft 365: Pay-as-you-go storage for OneDrive
items.description: New pay-as-you-go, consumption-based meter for additional OneDrive storage. Control which OneDrive accounts can grow beyond their licensed storage limits and give selected users more space as needed.

items.title: Outlook: Instantly Find Rules, Quick Steps, and More by Name
items.description: Managing your email automation in Outlook is now effortless with name search built into your key productivity tools. You can search within Rules, Conditional Formatting, Quick Steps, and Search Folders, filtering the list by name so you jump straight to the item you need. Whether you have dozens of rules or a growing library of quick steps, just type a few characters to narrow down results instantly. No more scrolling through long lists to find the right one, search puts you in control. Stay org

items.title: Outlook: Sort by flag
items.description: We are adding support for sort by flag status, flag due date and flag start date.

items.title: Outlook: Play a Sound Rule
items.description: Users can set up Outlook rules to play a sound or show a desktop alert whenever an email that matches your chosen conditions arrives, whether it’s from a specific person, includes certain words, or meets any other rule criteria you define. These features help you stay alerted to the emails that matter most. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Microsoft Places: Microsoft Places Support to GCC cloud
items.description: Microsoft Places features will now be available in GCC cloud

items.title: Outlook: Rule to display desktop alert
items.description: Create rules that trigger a desktop alert when specific emails arrive. This makes it easier to stay on top of important messages without missing a beat. Look for the new "Display a Desktop Alert" action when setting up or editing your rules. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Outlook: Rule to display desktop alert
items.description: Create rules that trigger a desktop alert when specific emails arrive. This makes it easier to stay on top of important messages without missing a beat. Look for the new "Display a Desktop Alert" action when setting up or editing your rules. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal:  eDiscovery (Premium) – Hold reports (U.S. Government clouds)
items.description: Out-of-the-box reports that contain information about all legal holds associated with eDiscovery cases in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Sort and filter your view based on various criteria and download the aggregated information for further analysis.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys: Stop tracking email opens without disabling other tracking
items.description: Choose whether to track email opens separately from other tracking in Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys. A dedicated consent purpose lets you omit tracking pixels from new emails while link clicks, website interactions, UTM parameters, and form prefill continue to follow their existing tracking consent settings.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Improved device settings experience on Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: We’re enhancing the on-device admin settings experience for Teams Rooms on Android by improving information structure, organization and navigation. These updates make it easier for admins to find, understand, and adjust device settings directly from the console, improving overall usability and efficiency in room management.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Set wait times as short as 5 seconds in orchestration playbooks
items.description: Orchestration playbooks can now re-evaluate the conditions every 5 seconds instead of every 30 seconds. With this shorter interval, you get finer control over priority escalation and Bullseye pool expansion. As a result, conversations reach the right queue or specialist sooner when wait times or queue status change.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Human Resources: Expand talent sourcing through employee referrals
items.description:
Employee referrals provide organizations with an additional talent-sourcing channel by enabling employees to participate actively in the recruitment process.
This capability helps organizations:
Expand talent reach: Access potential candidates through employees' professional networks.
Reduce recruitment costs: Decrease reliance on external recruitment channels and agencies.
Accelerate hiring: Identify potential candidates more quickly through employee recommendations.
Improve employee engagement

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Customize how Recommended Actions are prioritized with custom instructions
items.description:
Administrators can customize how the Recommended Actions agent prioritizes actions by configuring natural-language instructions for individual source agents. This gives organizations greater flexibility to align AI-generated recommendations with their sales strategies while retaining the built-in intelligence of the Recommended Actions experience.
With this capability, administrators can:

Define business-specific prioritization criteria: Use natural-language instructions to express the organiza

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Trace conversation journeys end to end across your contact center
items.description: Journey Visualization brings live conversation data onto the map of your contact center configuration, so admins can see how conversations actually flow, not just how they were designed to flow. Admins can spot patterns across many conversations, then select any single conversation and follow its path step by step, from arrival through routing and queues to resolution.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Visualize and manage your contact center setup with visual designer
items.description: Visual Designer shows your entire contact center configuration as one interactive map: channels, workstreams, classification and routing rules, queues, and overflow handling, and how they connect. Admins can see how conversations will flow, spot gaps or misconfigurations, and make common changes, such as moving representatives between queues or updating routing, directly on the canvas instead of navigating many separate settings pages.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Choose a Profile at Startup
items.description: Microsoft Edge is introducing a profile picker at startup, making it easier to begin each browsing session with the right profile. Users can choose among their work, personal, or other available profiles, add a new profile, or browse as a guest before opening the browser. This helps users keep their browsing data and activities in the intended profile, while the Show on startup setting lets them control whether the picker appears at launch.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): The more you use Copilot in Office the better it gets
items.description: Copilot in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Workspaces across Copilot App and OneNote will use memory to learn your work patterns and personalize responses. With memory, Copilot can offer more relevant suggestions, hold the pen in a way that represents you, and adapt to your preferences over time

items.title: Outlook: Add Custom Flag Descriptions for Clearer Follow-Ups
items.description: You can add custom text to an email's follow-up flag to describe what you need to do. Use your own words to capture the next step for each flagged message. This gives you a clear reminder of why you flagged the email when you return to it. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: PowerPoint: Customize your Presenter view layout
items.description: New controls in Presenter view will let you reposition and resize the speaker notes, set speaker notes to a specific text size, and customize the position of slides and notes into a view that works for you. The existing layout will remain the default unless you change it.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Voice phishing detection for external calls
items.description: Voice phishing detection helps protect Microsoft Teams users from potential scams during one-to-one calls with people outside their organization. Using AI, Teams analyzes conversations for signs of social engineering and alerts recipients when suspicious activity is detected, helping them recognize potential threats and decide how to proceed.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Enable version trimming for data covered by retention policies in OneDrive and SharePoint
items.description: Let tenants trim file-version bloat created by retention, without breaking compliance promises. SharePoint/compliance admins at large, regulated enterprises must cap and reclaim storage consumed by retained file versions, while keeping legal-hold and records promises intact. Admins with appropriate Purview RBAC can enable version cleanup for ODB/SPO content even when retention policies are in effect. This would be a policy scoped setting that essentially overrides the default behavior where all

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Engage - Improved shared messages end-user experience
items.description: Improving the shared conversation experience in Viva Engage to so it's easier for users to discover, read, and participate.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Apply Purview network data security DLP policies to all websites, or all websites except specific cloud apps, through Entra GSA Internet Access integration
items.description: With this feature, admins can scope their network data security data loss prevention policies, integrated with Entra GSA Internet Access, to apply to all websites (.) or all websites except specific cloud apps, allowing them to apply protection to cloud apps and websites that are not in the Defender Cloud App Catalog.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Events now support up to 20,000 registrations, making it easier to reach and engage larger audiences at scale
items.description: Connect with more attendees than ever before with Teams Events, now supporting up to 20,000 registrations for organizers with valid Attendee packs.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Ensure regulatory compliance by deleting inactive OneDrives and mailboxes for departing employees
items.description: Enables admins to delete both content and containers for departed users at scale thereby keeping your tenant compliant without any manual effort.

items.title: SharePoint: Changes to the FAQ web part authoring experience
items.description: The SharePoint FAQ web part will provide a standard, non-AI experience for manually creating, editing, and managing FAQs. The AI-assisted FAQ creation and import will move to the Copilot in SharePoint authoring experience, where authors can use natural-language prompts and selected grounding sources to generate FAQ content that is saved to the compatible FAQ web part. Existing FAQ web parts and their content will continue to render without migration.

items.title: Planner: Capacity view
items.description: Capacity view shows a timeline of who's working on what, so you can see how work is distributed across your team and spot overload or open capacity at a glance.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
items.description: Access to Archive mailboxes (Main + Auxiliary) through Microsoft Graph. The goal is to give users a single, seamless Archive view, even though Archive data may physically reside across multiple auxiliary mailboxes with EWS Graph APIs getting deprecated by OCT 2026.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Ensure regulatory compliance by deleting inactive OneDrives and mailboxes for departing employees
items.description: Enables admins to delete both content and containers for departed users at scale thereby keeping your tenant compliant without any manual effort.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Rights Management connector – Certificate-based authentication
items.description: The Microsoft Rights Management (RMS) connector is moving from shared-secret authentication to certificate-based authentication, improving its security posture. With this update, administrators configure their own Microsoft Entra app registration and certificate, then use the new PowerShell module to configure the certificate for each workload (Connector, Exchange, SharePoint, and FCI). New PowerShell cmdlets handle certificate import, registry configuration, private-key permissions, and validat

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Archive SharePoint files under retention policies
items.description: With the introduction of file archiving support in SharePoint Online, administrators are looking to seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. This means that, in addition to keeping or deleting data, admins want to now leverage Purview DLM to archive files according to organizational requirements, ensuring comprehensive governance across all stages of the content lifecycle in SPO. Retention based file archiving moves inactive content to low-cost storage,

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Archive SharePoint files under retention
items.description: We are introducing file archiving support in SharePoint Online, utilizing this feature administrators can seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. This means that, in addition to keeping or deleting data, admins can now leverage Purview DLM to archive files according to organizational requirements, ensuring comprehensive governance across all stages of the content lifecycle in SharePoint Online. items.title: Microsoft 365 app: Microsoft Places Support to GCC High
items.description: "Microsoft Places is an AI-powered workplace app for flexible work. Places helps organizations reimagine flexible work with AI, enables employees to connect more easily in person so that they can make the most of in-office days.
